column1: # What the state telecom carriers' own notices, and others' accounts of the same purchases, say about the chips in the carriers' purchases of AI computing, August 2023 to November 2026: 120 rows, one per finding of a later search that a first reading against the saved page found supported or partly supported; made on Nov 25, 2026, the last ten rows added on Nov 26, 2026 from saved pages that no table had yet used. who_states classes each page by its own heading or signature: a carrier's own notice, in the original, on its tender agent's page or in a copy on a tender site (40 rows); a carrier's own filing (1) or news page (1); a tender site's or a data site's own record of a notice, a summary or its fields rather than the notice's text (5); a winner or supplier, in its own filing or page (27); the press, trade press or a relay (33); a broker's report, or a securities firm's opinion filed as a company's financial adviser (12); a press release of Nvidia (1). Three columns are COUNTS of words on the saved page (Nvidia's name and chip models; the word 国产 and home-made chip names; the software labels CANN and CUDA), and a fourth notes the form's clause on where products may come from. The counts follow one rule, on the page as a visitor sees it, each article once: for a web page, the text of its body as shown, without scripts, styles, comments, the head and its title, and without elements the page's own markup hides (where the page shows one of two copies of its article by screen width, one copy); for a PDF, its text. A Chinese word broken by a line end is joined, and a string inside another word is not counted. The words: 英伟达, NVIDIA in any case, NV RTX, NV Tesla, and H800, H100, H200, H20, A800, A100, L40, 4090 and 3090 as models of their own; 昇腾, 鲲鹏, 海光, 寒武纪, 平头哥, 真武, 昆仑芯, 国产 and NPU; CANN and CUDA. A word on a page is not a statement about the purchase: the entries of OFFICIAL_RECORD.md, section 3.6, say what each page states. On 45 of the 47 rows of the carriers' own notices, filing and news page and of the sites' records of their notices (37 of 39 pages) the count of Nvidia words is none; the other two are a tender dated Sept 23, 2024 by a Jiangsu company that bears China Unicom's name and publishes its tender on China Unicom's procurement site (the notice names no owner; it is counted here with the carriers' own notices), to rent computing, which names three cards as NV RTX 3090, NV RTX 4090 and NV Tesla A100, and a call of Aug 26, 2026 by China Unicom's Shenzhen company for software services, which asks that the software run on NVIDIA GPUs and Ascend NPUs alike and buys no chip; control: the same count finds 英伟达 4 times and H800 8 times on a relay of a 2023 tender of China Mobile's Shanghai branch (two rows). first_reading_verdict is the verdict of the first reading, and the last column the finding as read, with that reading's correction where the verdict is partly; first_reading_quote_found_by_script says whether the sentence the reading quoted from the page was found in the saved copy by script (112 yes; 7 no, which are leads only; 1 not found at the first reading and found at a second). The date column is the search's date for the notice or event; for China Telecom's N-series tender the saved copy of the notice (four rows) prints only the tender site's listing date, Nov 17, 2026, and the Nov 16 is a trade site's, whose report of Nov 17 says the tender was launched the day before (four more rows rest on that report). Not a census: the carriers' own procurement sites gave no readable page, so their notices are held as tender sites and one agent's site carry them.
